phase_prompt.label: Default
phase_prompt.summary: The entity stands as a silent sentinel in the upper atmosphere, embodying the dormant potential of the system's next iteration. Its internal lights are dimmed to a warm, standby amber, and it observes the curvature of the sky dome with mechanical patience.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A medium-long shot of the Power of the Heaven entity standing on a layer of semi-transparent data-clouds in the upper atmosphere. The entity's obsidian shell is dark, reflecting the star-grid above. Weak, amber light pulses slowly from deep within its chest cavity. The mood is quiet, contemplative, and heavy with the anticipation of a system reset. The camera focuses on the texture of the obsidian and the faint heat haze rising from the entity's form. Photorealistic, cinematic drama, depth of field.
